purpose: Measure full-parameter training throughput and separate optimizer cost from forward/backward. No selected model or quality promotion.
required_checks: Every original parameter remains trainable and belongs to the optimizer exactly once.
All 381 original parameter tensors have nonzero gradients and change by SHA256 comparison.
Loss and clipped global gradient norm remain finite.
Fresh outputs; preserve failed arms; do not repeat a guard failure at relaxed limits.
limits: Three updates on an exposed short-sequence diagnostic; no sustained or long-context qualification.
AdamW changes the update algorithm while preserving full training scope; no convergence parity is assumed.
No weight exports, downloads, historical checkpoint modification, selected/default change or GPU allocator limit change.
CUDA hardware comparison is sourced specifications and explicitly labelled estimates unless matched execution exists.
